summary: Frontend-only E2E review completed for the unauthenticated beginner level test/gate and secretary RH employee profile. Immediate correct/incorrect feedback, the Q5 gate content, email/password secretary login, RH data, and complete employee modal passed on desktop; gate and modal also remained usable on mobile. Found a broken registration CTA, duplicate-answer score inflation, stale pack pricing, mobile dashboard overflow, and accessibility/semantic issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Double-clicking Valider ma reponse sends two check-answer requests and increments a correct answer twice; reproduced score is 2 / 1.
Profile icon buttons have no accessible name (aria-label was null), and opening the employee dialog repeatedly logs a missing DialogDescription/aria-describedby warning.

integration_issues.issue: S'inscrire gratuitement and each pack target /register, but App.js defines no /register route. Clicking the required registration CTA renders a blank page and logs 'No routes matched location /register'.
TestPage hardcodes K-Debutant at 60 EUR and K-Avance at 120 EUR while the live /api/pricing response is 76 EUR and 102 EUR respectively, so prospects see stale prices.

issues: At 390px width the page scroll width is 669px before and after opening RH, causing horizontal overflow; the six-tab TabsList is not responsive/scroll-contained.
The gauge is labeled Utilisation and displays 0%, but its bar is 100% filled because width uses remaining/earned rather than the displayed utilization percentage.

action_items: Guard answer verification with an in-flight state and disable test-next-button so one question can only be scored once.
Route gate registration to the existing registration entry point (currently /?openRegister=true#pricing) or add a real /register route; fix pack-card destinations too.
Load gate pack prices from /api/pricing instead of duplicating hardcoded values.
Make the secretary tab bar responsive/scrollable without expanding the document beyond the mobile viewport.
Add accessible labels to profile icon buttons, add DialogDescription or aria-describedby, and align the gauge bar with its Utilisation label/value.
Retest all corrected flows on desktop and 390px mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: TestPage.handleNext has no submission lock. Concurrent responses both run setCorrectCount(prev => prev + 1), while each writes an answer array from the same stale closure, producing impossible scores such as 2/1.
App.js has no /register route although TestPage uses it for the main gate CTA and every pack card. The app's existing registration entry point is a homepage query/hash route.
PACKS duplicates pricing rather than using /api/pricing and is already inconsistent with live data.
SecretaryHR defines EmployeeRow and EmployeeProfileModal during render; ESLint flags both as unstable nested components, causing subtree remounts and repeated dialog warnings on state updates.
TestPage RadioGroup changes from uncontrolled to controlled on every question, generating a console warning after option selection.
SecretaryDashboard.js remains far above the 700-line maintainability limit and should be split into feature modules.

success_rate.frontend: 82% - all four requested screens/primary flows rendered, but registration is broken and three additional UI correctness/responsiveness defects were reproduced

seed_data_creation: None; used existing beginner questions, employee data, and the supplied secretary account.
test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md and used secretaire@mykalamaenglish.com / kalamasecret as requested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retest double-click on test-next-button (must produce exactly one request and score 1/1), complete five unauthenticated answers and click gate-register-btn, compare gate prices with /api/pricing, then verify secretary dashboard document scrollWidth is <=390 at a 390px viewport. Secretary email/password login now redirects directly to /secretary and the RH employee profile passed with 5 employees.
rca_of_the_issue: Registration fails because TestPage links to an undefined React Router path. Score inflation is a client-side race caused by an enabled async submit control and duplicate state updates. Stale prices come from duplicated constants. Mobile overflow comes from the fixed six-item tab row. Employee dialog warnings stem from missing accessibility metadata and unstable nested component definitions.
